French wildfires threaten Tour de France's third stage

Wildfires in France have forced officials to ban the public from the finish line of the Tour de France's third stage. The event was originally scheduled to take place in a rural area, but the fires have made it unsafe for spectators. The Tour de France is an annual cycling competition that takes place in France and other European countries.
